notes.title: Designer DLC coming on November 16
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Fossil Hunters![/h1]

We have some exciting news for you! We’re happy to announce that our previously announced [b]Designer DLC will be released on November 16[/b]!

[previewyoutube=Q13A2P5MtbQ;full]TRAILER[/previewyoutube]

This DLC introduces life-sized [b]dinosaur models[/b] of every species currently present in the game, which you can [b]paint any way you like[/b]! Dinosaur lovers fond of realistic portrayal can bring to life their favorite dinos and create amazing scenes with realistic colors and subtle details. On the other hand, those who are willing to let their imagination run wild can create unique designs for their dinos not seen anywhere else! Every approach is a good one. We only give you the tools to bring your ideas to life. ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/10428ac71a93c0e14cd1e9b28d7588e556556ca5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/20b1c5820b42060b3065da5e95c1292300945561.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/0cd690bd5490dd26446e57bf6095d1e71f24823d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/f93ea2f36a6ad4c63643fa8f97e6e66eef9cc189.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/11eb5fa8eb41e64f6b203434b1879f6dae72b2b5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/5d072c0970173a21012d3fd3c1f2e07b743da97b.jpg[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/55f03fc2b68871b59209d2a0e16bfe75dbf4d161.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/23bf101ae76c4d0a3932a19ad67b8d7a8553f6e6.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/818609e14ff5bdd9a8a6a3a89b40a756144f906c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/211a653d77b3ad221e3325a972f076b04d6b0473.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/0cf027305792c4f754e1524cf47afe9fb9bf0d78.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/88f5db9d0c8951fbe5ad5aabcf385409ef87e396.png[/img][/url]


We’re sure they’ll bring a lot of variety to your museum and we hope that with this small personal touch, your museum will become truly yours.

[b]Designer DLC will include:[/b]
[list]
[*] 10 Dinosaur species to paint
[*] 10 poses for each Dinosaur species to arrange your display
[*] 2 gameplay modes:
[*] Normal (which takes game progression into account)
[*] Sandbox (which allows you to paint every Dino from start)
[*] 50+ textures for skin, scales etc...
[*] 30+ skin patterns and decals
[*] 20+ blood decals
[*] Full color palette
[*] 130+ texture sets with skins
[*] 20+ independent textures for free combination with skin textures
[*] 30+ additional decals for museum decoration in 2 color variants
[/list]

Remember to [b]add Designer DLC to your Wishlist[/b] to receive a notification right away when it becomes available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065550/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter__Designer_DLC/

We’re already working on additional content! More info soon! :)

Stay tuned!

Kind Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: May the 4th be with you!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Fossil Hunters![/h1]

A lot has happened since the time of our release date announcement. It turned out that April is bringing to the table many great games. After careful consideration, the decision was made to [b]postpone release of our Dinosaur Fossil Hunter for one more week[/b]. 

[h3]The new release date is 4 May 2022![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/ff586ee21c8edf1cdd01659ce5512bb732d9f800.png[/img]

We’d like to tell you about many additions that are coming to the full version of the game!

[h2]NEW FEATURES: [/h2]

[h3]Even more languages![/h3]

With the help from our amazing translators, we can [b]expand the list of supported languages[/b]! 
We will include the following additional languages:
[list]
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Turkish
[*] Dutch
[*] Portuguese
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/78ab635b21a522c999ccfb8e6ca41854bd7a6873.png[/img]

[h3]Partial Steam Workshop Support[/h3]

That’s a big spoiler, but we thought that many of you might be happy to know that we have included [b]partial Workshop support[/b] in our game! Are you happy with your museum exhibitions? You’ll be able to share your museum in Steam Workshop and allow other players to visit it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/bc107f64e2b5af77e7e872b98f72a0ec90f4bd12.png[/img]

[h3]Voice-over[/h3]

Our protagonist now has a [b]voice[/b]! For the full immersion and to enhance the narrative part of the game, the narration in text will now be accompanied by a voice of the lector. We hope this will make your experience even more magical.


[h3]Achievements[/h3]

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter will include [b]over 70 Achievements[/b] for all the achievement hunters out there! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/f8f9868cad1097498d8107d59d4f2207a872639f.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2]

[h3]Improved Tutorial[/h3]

We know that tutorial plays a big role in shaping first impressions about the game. That’s why we do our best to gather feedback at every possible stage. For a long time, our QA team has been our primary source of feedback but thanks to our recent playtests we were finally able to hand the game over to you – our players! We have gathered a lot of invaluable suggestions and based on that, tutorial in the full game will be improved. One of the more notable changes is that instead of static graphics, [b]Help panels will now include short recordings showing certain features in action[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/0f72379a5cc2bf8072f193863a6e2ecd18649274.gif[/img]

[h3]Waypoints[/h3]

[b]More waypoints and additional information such as room and location descriptions[/b] have been added in order to make it easier for you to find your way. You don’t have to worry about getting lost as the game will be sure to nudge you in the right direction if needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/7bcdb80436e2710f021636199c933b9ef31b7bf1.png[/img]

[h3]Controller support[/h3]

We have been working on [b]controller support system[/b] for quite a while now and playtests allowed us to address many issues so in the future, you'll be able play the game the way you like. Would you like to use your favourite game controller? Go for it! You'll be able to choose from dedicated settings for Xbox 360, PS 4, PS 5 and Xbox One controller, as well as set up your own configuration.

[h3]Upgraded mechanics[/h3]

A lot of in-game mechanics have been improved thanks to our playtesters, including a [b]water pump[/b], which should be much more intuitive to use in the full version of the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6miJb92.gif[/img]

[h2]WISHLIST CHALLENGE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/1279dd6fb3dde6c90211f802476ea21fea5e4305.png[/img]

Remember about the Wishlist Challenge! 

If you’re looking forward to Dinosaur Fossil Hunter, we encourage you to [b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b]! Not only you’ll be notified as soon as the game is available, but you’ll bring us closer to one of the challenge goals listed above! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

Depending on the goal we reach by the release day, a corresponding [b]launch discount[/b] will be applied to the game’s initial price!

[h2]SCREENSHOT COMPETITION[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/2263a3464bbbddbf8e6dac3632373cf53ba39a09.png[/img]

In one of our last announcements, we also mentioned Screenshot Competition. With release date changed to 4 May, [b]deadline of the competition has been moved to May 4 as well[/b]. You have one more week to submit your entry. 

Is there any exhibition that you’re particularly fond of in Dinosaur Fossil Hunter: Prologue? [b]Take a screenshot and share it with us on Twitter![/b] Make sure to include [b]#DinosaurFossilHunter[/b] hashtag so we can locate it. 

3 winning entries will be featured in the game, while their authors will receive keys to these great games:
[list]
[*] Barn Finders
[*] Rover Mechanic Simulator
[*] Tank Mechanic Simulator
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/8b530ae2d15e69ac466d98d70a30973849c96a3f.png[/img]

You can find more information about the competition [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/864700/view/3177860631512955101][b]here[/b][/url].

You can also expect a [b]detailed roadmap[/b] of future updates on the game’s release day. 

May the 4th be with you! 🙂

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Devlog #23: Development status
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Fossil Hunters![/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GtjzOe5.gif[/img]

It’s about time to give you an update from the development front! 😃

EGX provided us with loads of valuable feedback. We’ve gathered everything we had learned by talking with players and our own observations and now we’re putting it to use. Unfortunately, as it usually is with development, whenever something is added to the game, some additional time is needed to address all the issues that pop up as a result. Rest assured, with our testing team aboard, we’ll prevail! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TE4nsSC.gif[/img]

We may not be able to provide you with many truly [i]new[/i] things, but we believe there is still a fair share of interesting things to show you. Let’s go!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3v9FPM4.gif[/img]

When you get to the excavation site, you need to secure the area. Before, you had to hold the Space button for a while – now, you can either proceed like before or simply press a button to skip this sequence and move on to the next step.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/beBdYaS.gif[/img]

We have polished the look of various animations you encounter during your fossil hunting. Now they look more natural. Take a look!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4oiOi4S.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NTflTAv.gif[/img]

Other than that, we have improved rock destroying mechanic. It works similarly to how it did before, but now it’s possible to destroy rocks other than the ones you encounter on the roads. For example, you can destroy rocks that get in your way while digging for paleontological treasures!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G1d9DZg.gif[/img]

Rock inspection has also been improved! Thanks to your feedback, Giger’s counter role has been expanded. After finding the rock with a fossil, you’ll need to perform a visual inspection, which will allow you to find places where the fossil sticks out of the rock. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2r6a6oB.gif[/img]

When you find and prepare your fossil for a journey back home, it’s time to move it to the car! Medium boxes come with this neat cover right here:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CuSaJiG.gif[/img]

While you’re already familiar with most of the game’s features, there is another one that will give you some room for customization. We have added the option to change the colour of your vehicle. You can freely change the colour of any car you can control in the game. Just make sure to make this colour pleasing for the eyes. 😉

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z20AblC.gif[/img]

We have also been working on including controller support in the game, as we recall that it’s something that a lot of you requested in the past. 🙂

What’s left now is to get rid of those pesky bugs and at last, get the game ready for you – our players and hope that this adventure we’ve been working so hard on will make you fall in love with paleontology all over again!

As a last piece of news for today, Dinosaur Fossil Hunter was chosen as one of ten Polish games to show up at WePlay Expo in Shanghai! The Prologue version will be presented during the event, which will take place on December 11-12. While we won’t be able to be there in person due to COVID restrictions, our game will be left in WePlay organizing party's care. If you haven’t tried the updated Prologue yet and have the opportunity to drop by, please do! 🙂

If you're not on our Discord server yet, we encourage you to join the community!
[url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url]

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Devlog #22: Improvements and a special feature!
notes.content:
[h2]We’re back, Fossil Hunters![/h2]

Along with us, we bring you another update regarding our progress on the game! 🤠

Our team continues working on the game’s balance, fixing and further improving the game by adding missing features. Balancing the game requires a lot of attention and cooperation from our development and testing team. Testers play and leave invaluable feedback, which our development team uses to adjust gameplay accordingly. It’s a continuous cycle, which – little by little – allows us to bring Dinosaur Fossil Hunter closer to completion.

In the past month, our team has grown considerably bigger as new dedicated team members have joined our ranks. 💪💪💪 With their help, we gained more time, which in turn allowed us to reconsider some of your suggestions and include them in the game.

[b]Some of the aforementioned features include:[/b]
[list]
[*] making your character visible at certain stages of the game,
[*] adding a possibility to draw a path on the minimap,
[*] reworked mechanics of securing an excavation site, which should now be more pleasing to watch,
[*] adding belts to hold crates on top of your car in place,
[*] improved vehicle physics.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/2662d1abbc468b1ea4fcec52e7336df10634efe5.png[/img]

Moreover, we have decided to do something special for our community. Our Kickstarter supporters may recall “Little Findings” listed among our stretch goals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/2371b69450d983729d28773975e7d2a8b1a5fe56.png[/img]

Unfortunately, the campaign ended with a sum just a tiny bit away from that goal and we thought we wouldn’t be able to include it in the game. However, with more people on board, Dinosaur Fossil Hunter team decided to bring this idea to life! We have already prepared [b]over 20 unique fossils[/b], which will make great additions to your museum displays! We are currently working on a way to transport these new fossils from an excavation site to a museum. 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/cb97954029efae24788df3d2808ddedddf6f8394.jpg[/img]

Keep in mind that’s not all! We have many more surprises in store for you, but we don’t want to spill out everything just yet. We’d like to leave some things for you to discover. 🙂

If you’re looking for a community of paleontology enthusiasts to talk about the game, consider joining or Discord channel! Like always, we also encourage you to add Dinosaur Fossil Hunter to your Wishlist – that is, if it’s not there yet. 😄

[url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url]

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter featured at PAX! – Update for the Prologue goes LIVE!
notes.content:
Exciting news, Fossil Hunters!

We have more surprises for you today! As it turns out, Dinosaur Fossil Hunter is featured at Camp PAX West Seattle 2021! 🥳 To celebrate, we're unveiling the [b]major Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Demo & Prologue update[/b] we have been working on alongside the full version of the game! It means that we’ve brought many of the long-awaited new features to Prologue and you can try them out today!

Here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*] translations added, available languages: English, Italian, Polish, German, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, French
[*] redesigned tutorial system [new screens, additional descriptions, waypoints etc.]
[*] redesigned UI screens [except tablet UI, WIP]
[*] upgraded map functionality [selecting and navigating to specific points]
[*] reworked exposure design system
[*] upgraded exploration workflow (new tool)
[*] upgraded excavation workflow [new steps and tools]
[*] improved fossil cleaning system [added possibility to highlight uncleaned areas, smoother tool work]
[*] improved vehicle camera
[*] improved models look & quality
[*] improved tools and tent animations
[*] improved skeleton assembling system [faster bone movement, added ability to put down]
[*] added drone for environmental screenshots
[*] visual polish & optimization
[*] many bugs reported by players have been fixed
[/list]

Have fun, explore and when you're done, make sure to share your feedback with us! We'd like to make use of this opportunity to gather your suggestions and make Dinosaur Fossil Hunter as good as possible! Let us know what you like and what may require more attention from us. It will help us greatly during further development. 😊

We’ll be awaiting your feedback on Steam forums and our [b][url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh]Discord server[/url][/b] while – of course – continuously working on Dinosaur Fossil Hunter! 💪

Make sure to add it to your Wishlist so you don’t miss any announcements! With that, the only thing that’s left is to wish you all a good time with the Prologue! 
Best Regards,

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Improved skeleton models, field trip and upcoming Prologue update!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Fossil Hunters![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rY07Rbu.gif[/img]

Now that we have finished working on gameplay mechanics that will be included in the game, we are now focused on improvements. That includes thorough testing, gathering feedback, making tweaks and balancing the gameplay and also making improvements in terms of performance. 

At the same time, we have also taken our time analyzing feedback from Steam, our Discord channel and other sources that you have provided us since the last prologue update. Based on that, we've picked out some gameplay elements that could be improved or added and we are also taking them into account while developing the game further.

[u]Here are some things we have been working on recently:[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/9511f2a3dee38bcfea5bc070995687ee4afb5c17.jpg[/img]

Thanks to our team members who have done thorough research and paleontologists who provided us with invaluable feedback, [b]we have significantly improved the quality of our in-game dinosaur skeletons[/b]! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eSImewy.gif[/img]

They are now much more detailed and anatomically close to real skeletons. Now, we are working on improving existing poses.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EOjPhGa.gif[/img]

As we have already mentioned, while we're working on balancing the gameplay progression, [b]the QA team is handling the internal testing[/b] and providing us the feedback necessary for further improvements.

Now a little fun fact: some of us had the opportunity to gain field experience by [b]participating in paleontological research ourselves[/b]! 😃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/65b0527eacaa6b6da33f0339a850216811de29d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/d30511bf81f8bf61dc9b6c84264ef5f342be5de9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/9f6ce512dafe421eca8de02917d22ab152519184.jpg[/img]

[b]We're also preparing an update for the Prologue version of the game[/b] – we have added many new gameplay mechanics that will be also included in the full version of the game. This update will come with an expanded tutorial, which will explain newly added mechanics. We hope that will make it much easier for you to jump right into the full game and start your adventure. 😉

Thank you for your interest in Dinosaur Fossil Hunter! Your feedback is a great help to us and we hope to write even more about changes made in the upcoming devlog! 

If you have something to share with us, we invite you to join our Discord channel.

[url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url]

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Prologue Update IV is now live!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Paleontologists! [/h1]

[b]Dinosaur Fossil Hunter: Prologue is now live! [/b] This update brings some big changes. The biggest one is [b]the key binding system[/b], [b]interactive cursor[/b] as well as [b]the additional autosave point in the garage.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/2b186c5d9118c22b3af69afedc7647036c2a0dbd.png[/img]

[u][h3]Update IV Changelog[/h3][/u]
[u][b]List of improvements:[/b][/u]
[list] [*] added key bindings
[*] added an interactive cursor to improve field work with tools
[*] inversion of the Y camera axis for the car
[*] improved car camera control
[*] improved gameplay optimization
[*] improved environment look and post-processing
[*] improved terrain textures
[*] improved sky and clouds
[*] improved swimming
[*] improved some sounds
[*] improved dust material on the fossil
[*] improved and rebaked occlusion [/list]

[u][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/u]
[list] [*] fixed “Scrap it” achievement bug
[*] fixed toy assembly bug
[*] fixed bug at bus scene
[*] fixed disappearing cursor
[*] fixed museum exposition bugs
[*] fixed restoring removed objects after loading
[*] fixed bugs with gameplay controls tips
[*] fixed doubled resolutions in the game settings
[*] fixed blackscreen while getting out of the car and resetting at the same time [/list]
[b]Warning: introducing these changes forced us to delete previous game saves.[/b]
As the Prologue story is linear we hope it won't be a big problem for you. This is a necessary step to introduce key bindings, new save system and to make the whole game better. We apologize for this inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter - Development Status & Holiday Greetings
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Paleontologists![/h1]

Since the beginning our goal was to create a fun Paleontologist Simulator - a unique game the world hasn't seen before. At the beginning of 2019, after long planning, we've started the production of this game and prepared a lot of content, then we decided to prepare Dinosaur Fossil Hunter [b]Demo Version[/b] to gather feedback about the game. Thanks to this Kickstarter and the great Community, we received many ideas on how to improve the game.

The next step was preparing [b]The Prologue[/b] with polished core gameplay and longer plot which introduced players to our game. Releasing The Prologue gave as an amazing opportunity to gather valuable feedback and many awesome ideas worth adding to the game, which would greatly enrich the gameplay.

In conclusion, after reading almost all your comments and discussing the feedback, we've decided to [b]add some big changes to the game[/b] based on suggestions that you've posted on [b]Kickstarter[/b], [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Discord[/b], but adding these changes and improvements requires additional time. However, we believe that this will make our game even more pleasant and satisfying. 

[i][b]Aside from originally planned features you will additionally find a lot of new things in the game,  the most important changes we decided to add are:[/b][/i]
[list] [*] Player XP progress with [b]skill tree[/b]	
[*] [b]Museum progress[/b] with upgrades	
[*] Ability to [b]shorten exploration or preparation phases[/b] depending on player level
[*] Different [b]bone workflows[/b] for small and medium sized bones with completely redesigned, more immersive look[/list]
It wasn't an easy decision, mainly because of one important reason - it extends the production time of the game, which is inconvenient both for you and for us. We need to reach the „roots” of the game and rebuild part of the mechanics, for example to enable [b]player progress[/b] during gameplay. This means that we will not be able to deliver the game to you as we previously planned - in December.

We hope to deliver [b]Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Early Access[/b] to you in [b]Q1 2021[/b]. We know that many of you are looking forward to the game and you wanted to play during Christmas. Despite these hard times, we're doing our best to deliver the game as fast as we possibly can, created by passionate players for players. After the Christmas break, we will provide you with more details regarding the development status. 

We are convinced that adding those changes was the right decision and we believe that longer development will definitely have a positive impact on the game that we're creating together with you. Every day we also work on Kickstarter goals to implement as many of them as possible before the release day. Thank you for your trust and understanding.


and one more thing...

[h2]Merry Christmas![/h2]

Christmas is just around the corner! May the Christmas Season bring only happiness and joy to you and your family. [b]We wish you a Merry Christmas! 🎄[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/29c15ce4a7daac8b3d4a51eea15dd0ec9c84c312.png[/img]

Stay safe and take care during the Christmas Season! 
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864700/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter/
